name: Benzoylecgonine
aliases: O-benzoylecgonine, BCG, BEG, Benzoylecgonine solution, Benzoylecogonine, Ecgonine benzoate, O-benzoyl-(-)-ecgonine
summary: Benzoylecgonine is the main metabolite of cocaine, formed by the liver and excreted in the urine. It is the compound tested for in most cocaine urine drug screens and in wastewater screenings for cocaine use.
